summary: Eight days to Expo (Nov 4). Pinecrest signed as the third design partner and Coastal logins are restored. Valley is already booking through Smart Slots. Booth print files are due tomorrow, and demo, load-test and rate-limit work continues. Harbor Foods renews Oct 30.

items.text: Coastal logins have worked since yesterday afternoon. Cause was an identity provider certificate rotation, and Arjun added a check. TW-144 closed. Maya called Grace (TW-145 done).
Pinecrest signed as the third Smart Slots design partner. TW-126 is done.
Pinecrest kickoff is Thursday and they want to be live before Expo. Jordan owns TW-151 (kickoff and data access), due Oct 29.
Valley booked 140 slots through Smart Slots yesterday. TW-121 (Coastal and Valley live) is still in progress, due Oct 30.
Maya wants four investor meetings booked at the booth during Expo. TW-152 is todo, due Oct 30.
Booth staffing will be two people at a time, in shifts. Maya wants the shift plan locked on Thursday.
Booth print files (TW-150) are due tomorrow, Oct 28, because the booth ships Thursday. Sam has it in progress.
Demo flow TW-119 is in progress, due Oct 30. Run time was 2:10 as of yesterday, and Sam wants it under two minutes.
Maya's 3-minute booth demo script (TW-120) is in progress, due Oct 30.
Maya created TW-153, a launch-day announcement post, due Nov 3. It is todo.
Scoring API passed a 5x load test. TW-115 is still in progress, due Oct 28. Nina's 10x test (TW-143) is due Oct 30.
Arjun's Expo tasks: TW-147 (demo environment with Coastal's anonymized data) is in progress, due Oct 29. TW-146 (rate limits) is still todo, due Oct 30.
Nina's tasks: Coastal ranking changes are in staging (TW-138, due Oct 28). Score caching for the booth demo (TW-148) is in progress, due Oct 30.
Leila merged empty and error states (TW-135 done). Booth tablet mode TW-149 is in progress, due Oct 29. Onboarding tooltips TW-123 are due Nov 2.
Jordan has the Smart Slots help center articles (TW-124, three for launch) in progress, due Nov 3.
Harbor Foods (38% of revenue) renews Oct 30. QBR notes were sent to Dana, the 4-week trend was added to its report, and sync alerts now go to its ops channel.
Ridgeline (yellow health, 22% of revenue) renews Nov 20 after repeated double-bookings. The duplicates fix is live. Renewal prep TW-113 is in progress, due Nov 13.
Smart Slots remains the company focus until Expo on Nov 4. Sync work was deferred unless sync worsened.
